narrative.overview: Social Trend Analyzer is conceived as a serious, scientific computational instrument—the digital analog to a high-density financial terminal or an empirical laboratory observatory. It completely rejects the superficial tropes of modern consumer AI SaaS products (floating glass cards, neon gradient blurs, oversized marketing hero banners, and generic rounded containers). Instead, the system prioritizes uncompromising data legibility, mathematical explainability, and structured information hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Architectural & Monochromatic with crisp 1px structural borders
Data-Led Color Semantics reserving saturation strictly for verified data states
Engineered Typographical Pairing (Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Sans + JetBrains Mono)
Compact workbench layouts with edge-to-edge dividers and zero nested cards
Verifiable computational integrity with zero fabricated metrics

rules.name: The Monochrome Foundation Rule
rules.body: 90% of any view must consist of canvas, surface, border, and grayscale typography. Colored pixels are solely semantic data carriers.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerical Rule
rules.body: All numeric scores, sample counts, coordinates, timestamps, and p-values must render with tabular figures and monospaced formatting.

rules.name: The Flat Architecture Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest with 1px solid structural borders. Drop shadows, glassmorphism, and neon halos are strictly banned.

dos: Do format all numerical data, scores, dates, and formulas in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do use 1px solid structural borders to establish clear visual boundaries between functional workbench modules.
Do provide explicit mathematical explanations alongside trend scores.
Do preserve high text contrast (minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds) across all views.
donts: Don't use purple, blue, or violet AI gradients across backgrounds, hero cards, or borders.
Don't use glassmorphism, background blurs, or glossy specular highlights.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons, filter tags, or status badges.
Don't use card borders with radius greater than 6px, and never nest cards inside other cards.
Don't rely on generic Inter-everywhere typography.
Don't fabricate or mock analytical scores; all visuals must reflect real calculations.
